values: The Outfall 001 authorization paragraph and its associated limits and monitoring table on the same page
Permit language linking Section A.1 requirements to actual discharge events or discharge types
Evidence of which discharge types occurred at Outfall 001 during Federal FY2025

grounding.location: Page: 3, Section: part_i, Outfalls 001 authorization paragraph

payload.rationale: The packet supplies the Outfall 001 authorization paragraph and the Section A.1 limits/monitoring table on the same page (value 1). The authorization lists four authorized discharge categories and states that 'Such discharges shall be limited and monitored ... as specified below,' which partially supplies permit language linking the table to named discharge types (value 2). However, the packet contains no observation establishing which discharge types actually occurred at Outfall 001 during Federal FY2025 (value 3). Without operational discharge-type evidence for the evaluation period, purposes A/B/C cannot establish whether Section A.1 numeric limits and monitoring requirements attach only to the four authorized categories or to any discharge from Outfall 001 while the authorization is in effect. The pronominal linkage in the permit text is insufficient to close that scope question for enforceability analysis, and there is no establishing evidence that limits apply to discharges outside the authorized categories (which would be required for REJECT of the narrow-reading proposition). Per P5, unsupported uncertainty is preferred to unsupported semantic closure.
